newsitem.title: UK: BFI down five on weaker Panamax fixings.
newsitem.headline: BFI down five on weaker Panamax fixings.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index was down down five to 1,252 points and the Baltic Handy Index was down six to 1,041 points on Thursday.

Despite reports of weaker transatlantic timecharter fixtures of Panamaxes and also strong rumours that Continental had booked Caribbean Sky for 54,000 heavy grain USGulf to Japan for June 18/26 at $19.90 no combo (down at least $1 from last done), brokers believed that the freight market in these sizes in the Atlantic might be levelling off.

Cargill were said to be indicating $20 no combo for their fresh order of 54,000 heavy grain USGulf to Japan for June 20/30 and there was a healthy volume of new enquiry from grain charterers in the Atlantic.
Rates for Panamaxes in the Far East were easier but brokers said that fresh enquiry for Capers in that area had probably stemmed prospects of Capers ballasting to Brazil.
At 1200 GMT BIFFEX was six points down to unchanged at turnover was 117 lots.
